mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting (particularly potassium and magnesium), which impairs dapagliflozin efficacy and increases risk of acute kidney injury; dapagliflozin may increase dehydration and prerenal azotemia during amphotericin B therapy.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and volume status closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation; assess benefit-risk of continuing SGLT2 inhibitor during amphotericin B treatment.
